config.stacking-mode.name: Stacking Mode
config.stacking-mode.tooltip: Independent: each application has its own timer, stacking effects only from different sources. Additive: stacks effects and adds timers. Refresh And Stack: stacks effects and resets the timer. Timer Only: extends the timer without stacking effects.
config.whole-day.name: Buffs Last All Day
config.whole-day.tooltip: When enabled, all food and drink buffs last until you sleep, regardless of their normal duration.
config.statue-stacking.name: Blessings Per Day
config.statue-stacking.tooltip: One per statue: place multiple Dwarf King or Blessings statues to receive one blessing from each, per day.
config.section.ore-nodes.tooltip: Controls which node types are affected by the '+1 ore from rocks' blessing. Vanilla applies it only to standard ore nodes.
config.calico-egg-nodes.name: Calico Egg Nodes
config.calico-egg-nodes.tooltip: Apply the +1 ore bonus to Calico Egg nodes. Vanilla omits these; enabling keeps them consistent with other ore nodes.
config.gem-nodes.name: Gem Nodes
config.gem-nodes.tooltip: Apply the +1 ore bonus to gem nodes (Diamond, Ruby, Jade, Amethyst, Topaz, Emerald, Aquamarine, random gem stones). Vanilla uses a fixed Mastery-based count for these.
config.mussel-nodes.name: Mussel Nodes
config.mussel-nodes.tooltip: Apply the +1 ore bonus to mussel nodes. Vanilla omits these from the ore blessing.
config.section.auto-pick.tooltip: Automatically select a blessing when interacting with the statue, using the priority ranking below.
config.auto-pick.name: Auto-Pick Blessing
config.auto-pick.tooltip: Skip the choice menu and automatically pick the highest-priority available blessing.
config.randomize-offering.name: Randomize Daily Offering
config.randomize-offering.tooltip: Roll the two offered blessings at random on first interaction instead of seeding them to the day. The same pair is shown until you pick.
config.section.blessing-priority.tooltip: Lower number = picked first (1 = highest priority, 5 = lowest). Used by Auto-Pick and as a tiebreaker when both offerings share the same rank.
config.rank-tooltip: Auto-pick priority for "{{blessing}}". 1 = always pick first, 5 = pick last.
config.priority.ore.name: +1 Ore from Nodes
config.priority.ladders.name: Ladders & Shafts
config.priority.ladders.blessing: greater chance to find ladders and shafts
config.priority.coal.name: Coal Find Chance
config.priority.bomb-immunity.name: Bomb Immunity
config.priority.geodes.name: Geode Find Chance
config.section.effect-stacking.tooltip: Uncheck an effect type to use vanilla replacement behavior for any buff that grants it, regardless of the global stacking mode.
config.section.effect-wholeday.tooltip: Check an effect type to make any buff that grants it last until you sleep.
